thread:
zoe: Quick note -- ran micro-onboard for ember-6b-quant with speculative prefill (budget=24) to check latency/quality tradeoffs.
Command:
```
./onboard_micro.sh --model ember-6b-q --speculative true --spec-budget 24 --evalset shortqa,long-narr
```
Summary: median latency -22%, throughput +1.6x, token cost -30%. Quality: small drop on shortqa EM (-0.8%) concentrated on questions requiring exact entity match; long-narr RougeL stable but hallucination detector up ~0.4%. Artifacts uploaded.

liam: How big was the eval and seeds?

zoe: 1.5k examples (shortqa 800, long 700), 2 RNG seeds. Metrics: EM/F1, RougeL, halluc-rate, divergence (KL first16).

farah: Did you isolate quant effects?

zoe: Yes. PTQ-8 without speculative shows no sig quality delta vs fp16. So suspect speculative merge.

liam: Can you paste per-budget snapshot?

zoe: quick ablation (single seed):
- budget=8: throughput +1.2x, EM d=-0.1%
- budget=16: +1.4x, EM d=-0.4%
- budget=24: +1.6x, EM d=-0.8%
- budget=40: +1.9x, EM d=-1.5% (hit perf ceiling)

farah: Looks monotonic. Any examples where speculative helps correctness?

zoe: surprisingly yes on ~5% of long-narr cases where model prefilled missing conjunctions that reduced ambiguity. So not universally bad.

liam: Suggest cheap scoring verifier: score prefix+candidate and reject if score delta > threshold. Test cost/benefit.

zoe: Ran verifier (score-only) -> recovers ~60% EM loss on shortqa, adds ~25ms median, ~90ms p95. Net p95 still ~15% below baseline.

ops-bot: uploaded artifacts: s3://redwood-staging/ember/1780012345/artifacts.tar.gz :package:

farah: Can we gate canary: block if shortqa EM drop >0.7% or KL(first16) > 0.03?

liam: +1. Also record per-example token diffs for root cause.

zoe: Will post CSVs and top-20 worst diffs to the ticket and schedule 15m sync tomorrow.
